mainEntity.name: How does garage insulation installation actually work?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical project starts with an assessment, then the installer seals air leaks and adds insulation to the walls, ceiling, and sometimes the garage door. For unfinished walls, batts or rigid foam may be used; for tighter spaces or better air sealing, spray foam is often considered; finished walls may need a different approach such as drill-and-fill or targeted upgrades.
acceptedAnswer.description: The installer usually checks the garage, seals leaks, then insulates walls, ceilings, and sometimes the door. The exact method depends on whether the garage is finished, unfinished, attached, or detached.
